name: Ascenix
long_description:
Ascenix is building one custom interface for running senior homes. We combine reusable building blocks into workflows tailored to each home's existing processes, from incident reporting to reimbursement. Homes get custom software without hiring an engineering team.

Living in a retirement home convinced us that the best way to improve residents' lives is to improve the systems staff rely on. As the older population grows, care teams need more time and resources. Repetitive reporting, missed reimbursement, and compliance problems take those away. Disconnected products that solve each of these individually add costs and leave staff moving information between systems.

Our building blocks gather information from EHRs like PointClickCare and other sources, process it, apply rules, and produce reports, tasks, or emails. Incident reporting and reimbursement reviews usually come from two separate vendors. Ascenix builds both from the same blocks, in one interface, so data isn't stuck in silos. Homes start with their biggest bottleneck and add workflows as priorities change.
one_liner: Custom software for senior care facilities.

launches.title: Ascenix - Custom Software for Senior Care Facilities
launches.tagline: Ascenix is building the single interface for running senior homes.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re Rishi and [@Ayaan Esmail](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/320011), co-founders of Ascenix. We lived in a retirement home for a few months and built Ascenix from what we learned.

**TL;DR:** We’re building one interface for running senior care homes. Ascenix combines reusable building blocks into workflows tailored to each home’s existing processes, from incident reporting to reimbursement. Homes get custom software without hiring an engineering team.

We grew 15% over the past week and now serve facilities across Ontario, Massachusetts, Ohio, Florida, and beyond.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cMD5rZ1U5EQ>

**Why we’re building this**

We grew up volunteering in retirement homes and built hardware, including this [patented fall detection sensor](https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2025129326A1/en?oq=WO2025129326A1). Living in a home convinced us that **the best way we can improve residents’ lives is to improve the systems staff rely on.**

As the older population grows, these care teams need more time and resources. Repetitive reporting, missed reimbursement, and compliance problems take those away. Disconnected tools add costs and leave staff moving information between systems. Ascenix aims to solve both.

**How it works**

We’re building reusable building blocks that gather information from health records and other sources, process it, apply rules, and produce reports, tasks, or emails.

For example, Incident reporting and reimbursement reviews are two common workflows staff buy software for. With Ascenix, we can generate both through the same set of building blocks and they have it in one UI so their data isn’t in silos.

Homes can start with their biggest bottleneck and add workflows as priorities change. **Our goal is one interface for senior care teams to deliver care and run their homes.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=126005&key=user_uploads/2282911/42a1eb65-dda2-4300-8bb5-d8539d914fb1)

**Our asks**

1. **Introduce us to senior care operators** across skilled nursing, long-term care, assisted living, or independent living. We’d love to meet owners and leaders in care, operations, finance, quality, or compliance. DM us for a three-line forwardable blurb.
2. **Connect us with founders building for senior care homes.** We’d love to explore ways to work together.

– Rishi & Ayaan
